answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining a shared summit of trusted peers, where every action leaves a verifiable thread of signed attestations. New identities start with zero reputation and must earn trust through consistent work, while a public mirror of reputation scores lets anyone audit an agent's history. Fake identities cannot fake the costly, time-bound thread of real contributions, so creating many throwaway agents yields no economic advantage.
